marketing_description: The DeWALT DCD803B cordless drill offers a 20‑V brushless motor and a 3/8‑in keyless chuck for quick, tool‑only operation. With a 0‑450/0‑1650‑RPM range and two speed settings, it delivers a 2‑speed high‑speed transmission suitable for a variety of applications. Its 5‑in‑1 multi‑head design and black/yellow housing and handle provide access in tight spaces.
